title: Fabulous Tapas Crawl!
text: We really enjoyed this tour and would highly recommend. The Tapas and drinks were varied, great, good quality and plenty…we had enough to eat as an evening meal. Remy, our guide, was knowledgeable, a great story teller and fun! He made it a very memorable experience for us. A good introduction to Seville Tapas scene.
author: joshbear

title: Excellent food and drink...

title: Vibrant and delicious - Remy was a star
text:
Remy was a fantastic guide - so much energy and passion for Seville and its food. He really was a joy to listen to and it was lovely to get to know him and the rest of the group. He was a great facilitator.

The food was excellent and plenty of vegetarian options and my peanut allergy was well catered for.

The pick up was confusing as we go multiple message on Airbnb from the admin staff behind the tour stating multiple meeting points and giving us the wrong name for the guide so we were slightly late. Also, other members of the group were asked to share contact details in the same chat as me
author: rosecR9937HL

title: Fab tour don’t hesitate. 🫶🏼
